public_rationale: The conditional forecast cannot yet be scored because its full antecedent is unverified. [Reuters](https://www.kitco.com/news/off-the-wire/2026-10-15/market-selloff-rising-rates-test-ai-data-centre-deal-boom) describes market stress, while [Kiplinger](https://www.kiplinger.com/business/ai-start-ups-keep-soaring-higher) describes continuing private-market enthusiasm. These records do not establish a common, broad contraction satisfying both conditions. No decisive event meets the early-resolution rule. Continued LLM use by itself would not confirm the conditional prediction.
limitations: Unknown condition status means unestablished, not disproved.

A narrower reading of the affected market could change whether the condition counts as met.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: If enthusiasm for GenAI dwindles and market valuations plummet, AI and LLMs will not disappear, and LLMs will still have their place as tools for statistical approximation.
conditions: if enthusiasm for GenAI dwindles and market valuations plummet

statement.excerpt: If enthusiasm for GenAI dwindles and market valuations plummet, AI won’t disappear, and LLMs won’t disappear; they will still have their place as tools for statistical approximation.
statement.document_title: Evidence that LLMs are reaching a point of diminishing returns - and what that might mean

from_speaker: their place as tools for statistical approximation
our_interpretation: Both conditions must occur together: a broad decline in GenAI enthusiasm and a sharp fall in relevant market valuations.
I read this as an industry contraction, rather than the failure of an individual startup or an isolated price movement.
Marcus supplies no index, percentage decline, duration or deadline. I do not add a numerical threshold.
Survival means continued practical AI and LLM deployment after the qualifying contraction. Statistical approximation includes useful probabilistic estimation or generation.
This is a sector-wide conditional claim, not a claim about a particular company's financial metric.
criteria.support_condition: A documented contraction meets both antecedents, followed by evidence that AI and LLMs retain practical uses, including statistical approximation.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After a documented contraction meeting both antecedents, reliable evidence establishes disappearance of AI or LLM use, or loss of the claimed practical role.

evidence.explanation: The report documents market stress and more selective investment, making it relevant evidence for the antecedent. It also describes continuing investment and does not establish a broad collapse in GenAI valuations.

evidence.locator: Paragraph immediately before the startup valuation table
evidence.explanation: This report describes continued private-market enthusiasm and rising valuations. It cautions against treating public-market stress as proof that the full industry-wide antecedent occurred, but cannot exclude every earlier qualifying episode.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Comparable evidence documenting a broad GenAI enthusiasm decline and sharp valuation contraction in the same episode, followed by direct evidence of continued practical AI and LLM use or their disappearance.
